sources.title: Aion 1.0: Microsoft's On-Device AI Models for Windows (2026)
sources.snippet: Microsoft announced the Aion 1.0 model family at Build 2026 — small AI models designed to run directly on Windows devices without cloud API calls. Two variants: Aion 1.0 Instruct (reasoning and instruction following) and Aion 1.0 Plan (planning, tool use, and agent workflows). sources.title: Junie: The JetBrains AI Coding Agent Leaves Beta | Try now
